description: The Hôtel de Ville of Sierre is the 17th-century mansion at Rue du Bourg 14, built for Jean-François de Courten and used as the town hall since 1964, facing its pedestrian square. This is the square, not the vineyard terraces above the old town already published. No word on the fronton is readable. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 16°C, with little wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
